text: In Tarski's stratification, the object language contains its own truth predicate that correctly ascribes truth to its own sentences, and this is what blocks the Liar paradox.
explanation: False. The object language L₀ specifically CANNOT talk about its own truth; the truth predicate True₀ lives in the metalanguage L₁ and applies only to lower-level sentences. It is exactly this stratification — a sentence may ascribe truth only to lower levels — that blocks the Liar, which would require applying the truth predicate at its own level.
